prompt:
Fix snippets/gift-card-balance-notice.liquid so it renders a gift card balance notice. It must handle null and empty-string inputs correctly. Inputs (all top-level variables, always supplied, but values may be null): - `balance_cents`: integer or null. The balance in minor units. - `currency_symbol`: string or null. May be empty or whitespace-only. - `last_four`: string or null. May be empty or whitespace-only. - `expires_on`: string or null. May be empty or whitespace-only. Rules: 1. If `balance_cents` is null, output nothing (empty string). 2. If `balance_cents` is 0 or negative, output exactly `

This gift card has no remaining balance.

`. Nothing else is output. 3. Otherwise output `
`, then the paragraphs below in this order, then `
`. a. Always: `

Balance: SYMBOL AMOUNT

`, with no space between SYMBOL and AMOUNT. - SYMBOL: `currency_symbol` with leading and trailing whitespace stripped. If it is null, empty or whitespace-only, use `$`. Otherwise use the stripped value, HTML-escaped with `escape`. - AMOUNT: whole units (`balance_cents` integer-divided by 100), then `.`, then the remainder (`balance_cents` modulo 100) always written as two digits. For example, 1205 gives `12.05`, 7 gives `0.07` and 100000 gives `1000.00`. b. Only if `last_four`, after stripping, is non-empty: `

Card ending in VALUE

`, where VALUE is the stripped, escaped value. c. Only if `expires_on`, after stripping, is non-empty: `

Expires VALUE

`, where VALUE is the stripped, escaped value. Note that in Liquid an empty string is truthy. Null, empty and whitespace-only strings must all be treated as missing for the three string inputs. The output must contain no whitespace or newlines between or around tags. Example: `

Balance: $25.50

Card ending in 4821

`. Use only core Liquid; the template runs with strict variables and strict filters. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/gift-card-balance-notice.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
